body: [text] on its own is [text define], which creates a named text: a list of messages, separated by semicolons or commas, that other [text] objects can read and edit. Its first argument selects another function: get, set, insert, delete, size, tolist, fromlist, search or sequence. With -k, the contents are saved with the patch.
